# brig sandbox exec

Run a command in a sandbox

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox exec [VM] SANDBOX -- COMMAND [ARG...]
```

## Description

Run a command in a ready sandbox, as openshell sandbox exec does, and exit
with its exit status. brig's own failures, before the command starts, exit
with the statuses that brig --help lists.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox exec dev webapp -- git -C webapp status
brig sandbox exec webapp --tty -- bash -l
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--env stringArray` | set a non-secret environment variable: KEY=VALUE (repeatable); attach a provider for secrets |
| `--no-login-shell` | run the command without the sandbox user's login startup files |
| `--no-tty` | give the command no terminal |
| `--timeout int` | stop the command after this many seconds (default: no limit) |
| `--tty` | give the command a terminal (default: when standard input and output are terminals) |
| `--workdir string` | run the command in this directory of the sandbox |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
